addendum_content_raw:
Part VIII - On 09/02/16. the 457 Plan (on Line 1) changed some of the funds offered in the plan and automatically transferred all assets in Allian NFG Value Fund

(line 3) to Wells Fargo Spec Sm Cap Val Fd (line 14) and transferred all assets in Artisan MidCap Value Fund (line 5) to Harbor Mid Cap Value Fund (line 15).

These transfers were done automatically for all plan participants by the plan administrators for their own reasons, and did not affect the value of the 457 Plan,
